name: Content library pricing block
purpose: Sell the content library add-on: explain what is included and let the visitor estimate a price for the packs they want before booking a demo.
description: Two-column grid (1.25fr / 1fr, gap 6rem; one column <=767). Left: yellow-chip eyebrow, H1 at h2 scale, grey intro and three independently toggling accordion cards (question + optional bold lead + answer). Right: a surface-2 content plan card with eyebrow, lead line, a static learners select, a question, two custom checkbox tiles (core library / sector packs), a computed placeholder price with a currency select, a primary CTA, and a yellow-tick feature list; under the card an outlined box runs a vertical testimonial ticker (logo, italic quote, avatar, name, role). Nothing submits: the checkboxes and selects only recompute the on-page placeholder price.

Checkbox tiles and selects change state instantly; the CTA has the primitive button hover.

evidenceNotes: /pricing renders <ContentPricing /> with no props; all sample copy is the component DEFAULTS.
The file comment describes the ticker as '850ms outQuart'; the shared TickerTrack actually uses ease 'power3.out' (GSAP's quartic out) with delay 6.

The two checkbox tiles live in a <form> whose onSubmit only calls preventDefault; there is no submit control. Prices are placeholder numbers computed client-side (15% bundle saving when both packs are checked; 'On request' for 5,000+).
The tiles' labels are modelled as planForm.fieldLabels (the component prop is `tiles`).
